description: 7 invented documents: versions of 6 invented knowledge-base records of an invented data-ingest service. Written by the authoring agent; no real project record or telemetry.
text_format: plain text; sections are separated by one blank line; the first line of a section is its heading

fields.doc_id: stable ID of one document: record_id, a dot, v and the version number. A document's text never changes after it is written
fields.record_id: the record this document is a version of (F04's record_id). The curriculum calls this the source ID
fields.version: version number of the record that this document holds (F04's record_version)
fields.arrival: when the document enters the corpus in this notebook: 0 = the initial corpus, 1 = added in STATE 9, 2 = added in STATE 10
fields.kind: record kind: policy, runbook or feedback (metadata, not indexed)
fields.valid_from: date from which this version applies (metadata, not indexed)
fields.title: title of the record (metadata, not indexed in this module)
fields.text: the document text: the only field that is chunked and indexed

documents.title: Retry policy for the batch importer
documents.text:
Scope
This record applies to the batch importer only. The streaming importer follows KB-0107.

Rule
Retry a failed job at most 3 times. Wait 30 seconds between attempts.

Rationale
Ticket TR-0042 showed that more retries overload the job queue.

documents.title: Failed messages in the streaming importer
documents.text:
Scope
This record applies to the streaming importer only. The batch importer follows KB-0101.

Rule
Do not retry a failed message. Send it to the dead-letter queue.

Rationale
A retry would deliver the message out of order.

documents.title: Deploy windows
documents.text:
Scope
This record applies to the production environment only.

Rule
Deploy on Tuesday and Thursday before 14:00. A deploy needs one reviewer.

Exception
The staging environment can deploy on any day without a reviewer.

documents.title: Cache invalidation runbook
documents.text:
Scope
This record applies to the metadata cache in production.

Procedure
Set cache.ttl_seconds to 0, then restart the cache workers one at a time.

Notes
Seen in build 0042 during work on TR-0043. Do not clear the cache during a deploy.

documents.title: Review feedback on the retry limit
documents.text:
Context
Review of TR-0042 for the batch importer.

Feedback
The retry limit must be configurable. Move it to importer.max_retries before the next deploy.

documents.title: Dead-letter queue retention
documents.text:
Scope
This record applies to the dead-letter queue of the streaming importer.

Rule
Keep a failed message for 14 days. Delete it after that.

documents.title: Retry policy for the batch importer
documents.text:
Scope
This record applies to the batch importer only. The streaming importer follows KB-0107.

Rule
Retry a failed job at most 5 times. Wait 60 seconds between attempts.

Rationale
Ticket TR-0058 showed that the larger job queue can absorb 5 retries.
